item.title: US President signs GENIUS Act into law, establishing first federal stablecoin framework with reserve requirements and audit standards.
EU MiCA grandfathering window closes July 1; only 244 crypto firms hold full CASP authorization across EU and EEA.
SEC sets July targets for three crypto rule proposals: token offerings, broker-dealer custody, and digital-asset market structure.
DTCC completes tokenized-securities pilot with 30+ firms including BlackRock, Goldman and JPMorgan; full platform launch set for October.
North Korea-linked Lazarus Group steals $643M in crypto during H1 2026, accounting for 55% of all funds lost to hacks.
Crypto industry loses $1.3B to hacks in H1 2026, on pace to surpass prior annual records, according to Chainalysis data.
AFX Bridge on Arbitrum drained of $24.15M in USDC on July 22; combined July DeFi bridge losses approach $100M.
More than 2,000 institutions now hold spot Bitcoin ETF positions, reflecting continued TradFi onboarding 18 months after US approval.
Spot Bitcoin ETFs record $510M in net inflows over three days in early July, led by BlackRock IBIT at $209M.
FATF finds 83% of jurisdictions have enacted Travel Rule legislation but only 40% enforce it; July sweep nets 5,811 arrests.
Mastercard pilots stablecoin card settlement with Rain; Visa expands stablecoin pre-funding on Visa Direct for cross-border payouts.
Germany BaFin blocks six offshore crypto exchange domains targeting German users without MiCA authorization.
Survey finds 90% of financial institutions have active stablecoin initiatives following enactment of the US GENIUS Act.
